name: Azalea Acres RV Park
note: RV park 1.5 mi off I-10 exit 53 near Robertsdale with grass and concrete sites in gravel loops, for short or long stays. Daily $49.92 including tax (effective April 2026); weekly and monthly rates plus electricity. RV Life 5*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: azaleaacresrvpark.com live with a price menu effective 2026-04-01 (daily $49.92 incl. tax) and phone; RV Life 5* $$ over 219 reviews. The 2026-06 AL sweep excluded it as 55+, but its own pages state no age limit
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 440 m frame) at 30.6251,-87.6060: four gravel loops of RV sites in a clearing off Glass Rd, woods around; no water - not waterfront

name: Shady Acres Campground

name: Hilltop RV Park
note: RV park on Co Rd 64 west of Robertsdale with a clubhouse, laundry and bathhouse, booked online through Campspot. Children are allowed only for single-night stays, not weekly or monthly. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude

waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 440 m frame) at 30.6254,-87.6251: rows of RV sites in open ground south of Co Rd 64, fields around; no water - not waterfront

name: Lake Eufaula Campground
note: Campground on W Chewalla Creek Dr in Eufaula with pull-through overnight RV sites, tent sites, a pool and mini golf. 30- and 50-amp sites $35/night plus 10% tax and a one-time $5 processing fee (2026); long-term sites are a separate section. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: lakeeufaulacampground.com live with an RV rate table (30/50A pull-through overnight sites $35 + tax) and phone; RV Life 4* $$ over 35, Google 4.1 over 337. The 2026-06 sweep deferred it on a satellite read of the long-term section; the overnight sites are published separately
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 440 m frame) at 31.9117,-85.1543: office, pool and wooded RV loops east of a long-term section, with Chewalla Creek ~100+ m north beyond a rail line and woods - not waterfront

name: Camellia RV Park
